title: Implement state machine with transitions
userStory: As a developer, I want tasks to follow defined state transitions so that the workflow is predictable and controlled.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid transitions: Draft->Triage, Triage->Planning, Triage->Ready (simple), Planning<->Research (loop), Planning->Ready, Ready->Executing, Executing->Complete, Any->Draft (reset)
Invalid transitions rejected with error message
Transition history logged on task (audit trail)
Status change triggers appropriate background jobs only when user initiates
UI buttons only show valid next-state actions
All transitions require explicit user action
